title: 13 Best Herbal Teas For Lice
intro: Herbal teas for lice are a natural and non-invasive method of treating head lice infestations, typically made by steeping dried herbs in hot water to create a soothing and medicated drink. The benefits of using herbal teas for lice treatment include their ability to gently calm the scalp, reduce itching and inflammation, and help eliminate the lice and their eggs. Examples of herbal teas that have been used to treat lice include peppermint, which helps to cool the scalp and reduce inflammation, chamomile, which soothes the scalp and promotes relaxation, and tea tree oil, which has antibacterial and antifungal properties that help to kill lice and their eggs. Other herbal teas such as lavender, rosemary, and eucalyptus have also been used to treat lice due to their antiparasitic and insecticidal properties, making them effective alternatives to chemical-based treatments.
